files.description: Shop purchases (900 rows): purchase_id (whole number), subscriber_id (refers to subscribers.csv; most subscribers have several purchases), store_city (city name; the same city is written with different capitals and extra spaces, e.g. "lisbon" and "LISBON"; about 2% empty), quantity (whole number), spend (two decimals).

task_text: Total the spend per store city. The city names are written inconsistently, so group on the name with surrounding spaces removed and each word capitalised; purchases without a city are left out. `result` should be a table with the columns store_city and spend, one row per city.
intended_computation: Tidy store_city (6 cities), drop missing cities and return store_city with the summed spend per city.

acceptable_variants.notes: spend may be rounded to 2 decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x keeping groups as columns drops a derived grouping key, so the table has no city column; 3.x keeps it

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
